newsitem.title: ITALY: Cold spell spoils spring-like weather in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Cold spell spoils spring-like weather in Italy.

text.p: Italy, which enjoyed spring-like weather just a week ago, faced a country-wide cold spell on Saturday as temperatures dipped to minus 30 Celsius (minus 22 Fahrenheit) in some parts of the country.
Snowstorms hit the central regions of the Marche, Umbria and Abruzzo as well as in the south in Puglia and the Aeolian islands off Sicily.
Sicilians had enjoyed warm weather until a week ago, with bathers taking to the water on beaches near Palermo.
The cold spell also left much of the Venice lagoon frozen. Television showed fishermen and gondoliers struggling to break the ice around their boats in the northeast city.
The lowest tempertature, minus 30 C, was registered early on Saturday in the Alpine town of Livigno but freezing temperatures hit most main cities including Rome, Milan, Florence and Turin.
There have been no reported deaths as a result of the cold snap but the Milan Metro has been left open at night to shelter the homeless.
